description:
Create and configure a new outbound polling campaign in Vicidial.

Login to the Vicidial Admin Interface (User: 6666, Pass: andromeda). Note: If prompted by a browser popup, use the same credentials.

Task Requirements:

1. Create a new Campaign:
   - Campaign ID: SENPOLL
   - Campaign Name: Senate Office Polling 2026
   - Active: Y
   - Dial Method: RATIO
   - Auto Dial Level: 1.0

2. Add Custom Campaign Statuses (Dispositions) to the SENPOLL campaign:
   - SVYCMP: "Survey Complete" (Selectable: Y, Human Answer: Y)
   - REFUSD: "Refused Participation" (Selectable: Y, Human Answer: Y)
   - LFTMSG: "Left Message" (Selectable: Y, Human Answer: N)
   - WRGPRS: "Wrong Person" (Selectable: Y, Human Answer: Y)

3. Create a new Script:
   - Script ID: SENPOLLSC
   - Script Name: Senate Polling Script
   - Text: "Good morning. My name is [agent_name]. I am calling from National Policy Research on behalf of a nonpartisan research initiative. We are conducting a brief survey about constituent services and legislative priorities. May I speak with a staff member who handles constituent communications? This call may be recorded for quality assurance purposes."

4. Configuration:
   - Assign the new script (SENPOLLSC) to the SENPOLL campaign.
   - Assign the existing list 9001 (US Senators 2026) to the SENPOLL campaign (it is currently unassigned).
